people's decisions can be influenced by reading conflicting narratives, but that this influence is moderated by the presence of irrelevant similarities between the narratives and subsequent decisions.

people are influenced by multiple narratives, but that the effects of this influence are often moderated by the details of the situation.
people are influenced by multiple conflicting stories, and that this influence is moderated by the extent to which the stories are similar to the situation at hand.
people are more likely to be influenced by narratives when the narratives are consistent and the situations are dissimilar.

people's decisions and confidence can be influenced by the details of the stories they have read, even when those details are not relevant to the decision.
the effects of narrative on people's decisions can be undermined by irrelevant similarities between the narrative and the situation.
